observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon camera body held in a hand, top controls and mode dial visible, lens mount open with no lens attached, text 'Canon' and 'EOS R10' readable on the body.
Photo 1 shows the front of the same body with the lens mount open, sensor visible inside, 'Canon' on the top plate and 'EOS R10' on the right side.
Photo 2 shows the rear and top of the body with viewfinder, LCD screen, command dials and buttons, no lens attached.
A watermark 'OLULEYE OLUBUKOLA' appears across all three photos.

claims.evidence: Brand and model text are readable on the camera in photos 0, 1 and 2.
All photos show the camera with no lens attached.
No battery or charger is visible in any of the three photos.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or has faulty buttons, dials, screen, viewfinder, or image capture.
risks.proof: Video of the camera turning on, navigating menus, taking a photo, and reviewing the image.

risks.risk: Shutter count is high or the shutter mechanism is worn.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the camera information menu showing shutter actuations.
risks.if_unproven: as a worn or high-shutter body

risks.risk: Sensor is damaged, scratched, or heavily dirty.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sensor under bright, even light.
risks.if_unproven: as needing sensor cleaning or repair

risks.risk: Battery or charger is missing, dead, or non-genuine.
risks.proof: Photos of the battery and charger plus a video of the battery charging the camera.
risks.if_unproven: as body only with no battery or charger

risks.risk: Lens mount or electrical contacts are damaged.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens mount and contact points.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, navigating menus, capturing and reviewing a photo
Close-up photo of the sensor under bright light
Screenshot of the shutter count / camera info menu
Photos of the battery and charger
Close-up photo of the lens mount contacts
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Canon EOS R10 body from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (non-working, no battery or charger) while proof is requested to raise the value.
